entire_comparison.parity_embedding: At parity p order plus modes by increasing x=p,p+2,... and R,L at each site.
entire_comparison.static_mask_scope: After the selector, the stationary physical read on the two input-embedding coordinates for the protected flag's cell zero, on both rails, can change during routed W ticks. All eight encoded protected masks were checked at each padded logical boundary. Their intermediate Heisenberg pullbacks need not be site masks.
entire_comparison.experimental_scope: Every reported good and bad route was executed as explicit W and J operations on one full integer mode vector. Switches inside routed permutation echoes were executed; no intermediate projective reads or symbolic swap replacement.

clock: Each None in the physical word is a forward W; [pre,x] or [post,x] is a forward W with a local coin exchange at site x, before or after its rail's H. J is an on-site exchange of the two rails at all sites. All inverse words are literal J,W,J.
scope: The supplied minus rail has the reverse propagation order and the transpose of the plus walk. Switches at the local coin are common to both rails. T=S X_all relates the minus-rail and plus-rail permutations. Neither spatial recurrence nor a negative clock tick is used. One logical H moves a parity register to the opposite parity.
